about: Every OpenSEO MCP tool, as the agent operation of the same name. `tool` runs it through OpenSEO's own MCP server; `sidecar` runs an operation of this install (a2app/app.mjs). `destructive: true` makes the person approve the call first: permanent deletions, public sharing, and anything that starts recurring charges. One-off paid runs need a cost cap from OpenSEO itself. Run a2app/gen-operations.mjs after any change.
